verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs describe syncs that map one model to a destination object/list/table with per-destination field mapping, unlimited destination counts, scheduled/CDC-based delivery, and run-level debugging, and a HN co-founder interview independently confirms declarative field mapping plus a claim of 70+ deep integrations with visual audience filtering versus competitors. Missing for 10: a public, browsable catalog page listing/counting all supported destinations, and detailed docs on per-destination filtering syntax beyond audience-level filtering.
